basis: OpenAI reference rates + user-supplied MAI-Image-2 starting rates (uncached inputs)
source: OpenAI: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing; MAI: user-supplied MAI-Image-2 starting rates applied to all MAI models
notes: GPT prices are public OpenAI reference rates, not verified Azure deployment prices. MAI-Image-2 starting rates are assumed for both MAI models at user request. No cache discounts, taxes, or negotiated discounts. Null means unavailable, not zero.
mai_rate_source: User-supplied MAI-Image-2 starting rates: $5 per 1M text-input tokens and $33 per 1M image-output tokens; apply to all MAI models.
mai_pricing_assumption: For estimation, price MAI num_output_tokens as image output. Raw response modality fields remain unchanged. Image-input pricing was not supplied; positive image-input tokens prevent a complete total.
